parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to obtain the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou:** the Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1:** outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the protected resource. Valid values:

*   **single:** protected object.
*   **group:** protected object group.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the protection rule template.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-template-resources --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --template-id 1020 --resource-type single --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --next-token AAAAAJ7ob70000000MhJJ1ELRE= --max-results 20 --resource abc.test.com-waf --asset-api abc.com --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeTemplateResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --AssetApi 'abc.com' --NextToken 'AAAAAJ7ob70000000MhJJ1ELRE=' --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --MaxResults 20 --Resource 'abc.test.com-waf' --ResourceType single --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --TemplateId 1020
